questions.question: What specific behavioral escalation thresholds must trigger a hard stop in 'Things to Try' to route teachers to institutional safeguarding rather than classroom strategies?
questions.why_it_matters: Ensures adherence to non-maleficence and child safety standards under the PEARL-AI ethical framework, preventing inappropriate AI intervention in critical child welfare or medical situations.

questions.question: How should 'CHLD Adapt' categorize and visually alert teachers when an adaptation modifies the underlying cognitive demand (e.g., recall vs. recognition)?
questions.why_it_matters: Protects curricular integrity and ensures teachers retain intentional control over assessment standards and classroom accommodations.

questions.question: What level of bilingual (English and Filipino/Tagalog) parsing and generation is required for the September 2026 pilot?
questions.why_it_matters: Directly impacts the accuracy of worksheet transformation and teacher behavioral intake in Philippine classroom environments.

questions.question: How will CHLD guarantee complete client-side or zero-retention privacy for unauthenticated v1 users who might input student PII?
questions.why_it_matters: Fulfills CHLD's privacy-first non-surveillance policy and satisfies pediatric data protection requirements.
